subject.title: 🐛 Producción: batería de errores recurrentes en logs de Vercel (admin 500 users, incidents 502, Serper 400, sharp, Amazon 429/confirmShipment, crons)

question: Should this production-log umbrella stay as a tracking issue, or should it be split into separate per-surface issues before any implementation work?
rationale: The evidence supports multiple real bugs, but the work spans unrelated apps and includes operator actions, so automation should not choose the tracking structure or ownership unilaterally.

options.title: Split by surface
options.body: Create or link narrow issues for admin users/order-products, Serper, Amazon confirmShipment/create throttling, Mercado Pago, cart conflict handling, PUDO timeout, and remaining ops-only actions.

options.title: Keep as umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as a manual tracking checklist and assign owners for each cluster without asking one PR to solve the whole batch.

options.title: Close only after follow-ups exist
options.body: Close this umbrella only once every still-relevant cluster is either fixed on dev or represented by a narrower canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Split by surface
recommendation.body: Create or link narrow issues for admin users/order-products, Serper, Amazon confirmShipment/create throttling, Mercado Pago, cart conflict handling, PUDO timeout, and remaining ops-only actions.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and have recent history on several central affected paths.
